- Articles / honorifics / pronouns: il paziente, un paziente, il Sig., il signore, lui, egli
- Past participles / adjectives in the masculine (-o) that agree with the patient: sottoposto, operato, affetto, trattato, portatore, pregresso, ricoverato
- Nationality / descriptive adjectives ending in -o that describe the patient: egiziano, italiano

FEMALE (output `female`) — any grammatical marker referring to the patient:
- Articles / honorifics / pronouns: la paziente, una paziente, la Sig.ra, la signora, lei, ella
- Past participles / adjectives in the feminine (-a) that agree with the patient: sottoposta, operata, affetta, trattata, portatrice, pregressa, ricoverata

## Priority rules
1. An explicit grammatical gender marker that refers to the patient (article, honorific, pronoun, past participle, or adjective agreeing with the patient) is DECISIVE. Use it.
